result.summary: The screen is mostly coherent, but the two horizontal/vertical card lists have clear layout defects: the 'Fastest near you' cards are vertically misaligned with inconsistent image heights, badge positions and one card appears to be showing a placeholder instead of a photo; the third card's title/price are clipped at the viewport edge, and the second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom nav with inconsistent favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the cards are not aligned on a common baseline: the 'Green Bowl Poké' image block is shorter and sits higher, 'Smash Bros Burgers' is shifted ~40px lower, so titles and delivery-fee lines appear at three different vertical positions.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel items a fixed image aspect ratio/height and align items to the top of the row (align-items: flex-start with equal card heights) so titles and prices line up.

issues.description: The third card ('Trattoria Piccol…', '€1.90 delivery') is hard-clipped at the right edge of the screen with no ellipsis or partial-card peek styling, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek offset to the carousel and truncate long restaurant names with an ellipsis inside the card width.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with −20% badge) is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and delivery info are not visible, so the list appears to end mid-card.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset equal to the nav bar height to the scroll container so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Inconsistent image treatment: the 'Green Bowl Poké' tile has a flat light-gray background with a centered illustration while sibling tiles use dark photographic imagery, suggesting a failed image load or fallback placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the real restaurant image loads, or standardize the fallback placeholder styling (same dark overlay/aspect ratio) across all cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons differ between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first is an unfilled outline with no background, the second sits on a dark filled circle.
issues.suggestion: Use one shared favorite-button component with a consistent scrim/background for legibility over any image.

issues.description: The time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') sit at different vertical offsets within their cards and one overlaps the card's bottom edge, breaking visual rhythm.
issues.suggestion: Anchor badges with a fixed absolute offset from the bottom-left of each image container.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no fade or partial-chip affordance, so users may not realize more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or consistent peek spacing to signal horizontal scrollability.
